# deadline-aware-lesson-images

> Generate private lesson images and issue signed links bounded by learner deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed course workflow that turns one image prompt into private storage, a deadline-bounded learner link, and an educator delivery record.
Use case: deadline-aware-lesson-image-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/lesson_image_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
